title: EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: EvoRouter：通过洞察引导的在策略蒸馏实现高性价比的多智能体路由

paragraphs.en: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter , a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance–cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router’s own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. Cost-aware reinforcement learning jointly optimizes task performance and computational cost. Together, these training signals internalize execution insights into the routing policy. The updated policy generates new trajectories that support subsequent insight extraction, forming an execution-driven self-improvement loop. We evaluate EvoRouter on 19 in-domain datasets spanning five domains and two out-of-domain benchmarks. EvoRouter achieves an average in-domain accuracy of 68.69%, outperforming the strongest routing baseline by 7.23 percentage points while reducing inference compute cost by 50.95%. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/CenYangtze/EvoRouter .

paragraphs.en: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly expanding the capabilities of Web services ( Moslem and Kelleher, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) , from information seeking to complex reasoning and problem solving ( Pesl et al., 2025 ; Izzi et al., 2025 ) . LLM routers have emerged as a key component of agentic infrastructure, selecting suitable models for individual queries to balance response quality and inference cost ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Ong et al., 2025 ) . With the growing adoption of multi-agent systems (MAS) in agentic web services such as Grok Bot and WorkBuddy, routing must extend beyond model selection to jointly determine model assignments, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and the skills and subtasks assigned to each agent. For service providers handling Web queries across diverse domains and difficulty levels, adaptively selecting MAS configurations to jointly optimize reasoning performance and compute cost has become a central research problem.

paragraphs.en: Existing MAS routing research primarily improves routing decisions through two mechanisms. Parametric policy optimization internalizes execution feedback into router parameters through reinforcement learning or feedback-conditioned distillation, learning policies for model assignment and system orchestration ( Yue et al., 2025b ; Su et al., 2026 ; Ke et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . Explicit experience evolution updates retrievable execution records, routing rules, or orchestration skills, allowing accumulated experience to guide subsequent decisions without gradient updates to the router ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Rajib et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Connecting experience reuse with policy learning is particularly challenging for joint MAS configuration: the benefits of a model, collaboration mode, or resource allocation depend jointly on task requirements and the surrounding configuration choices. Reusable experience must therefore preserve these conditions of applicability, while effective policy learning must translate the relevant knowledge into the ability to plan new configurations. As illustrated in Figure 1 , this raises a central open question: How can configuration experience be distilled into reusable knowledge of conditional dependencies and internalized in the router’s pre-execution planning policy to improve the system-level trade-off between accuracy and cost?
paragraphs.zh: 现有的多智能体系统（MAS）路由研究主要通过两种机制改进路由决策。 参数化策略优化通过强化学习或以反馈为条件的蒸馏，将执行反馈内化到路由器参数中，学习模型分配与系统编排的策略（Yue et al., 2025b；Su et al., 2026；Ke et al., 2026；Feng et al., 2026）。 显式经验演化则更新可检索的执行记录、路由规则或编排技能，使积累的经验无需对路由器进行梯度更新即可指导后续决策（Zhang et al., 2026a；Rajib et al., 2026；Lin et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a）。 对于联合的多智能体系统配置而言，将经验复用与策略学习相连接尤为困难：某个模型、协作模式或资源分配的收益同时取决于任务需求和周边的配置选择。 因此，可复用的经验必须保留这些适用条件，而有效的策略学习必须将相关知识转化为规划新配置的能力。 如图 1 所示，这引出了一个核心的开放性问题：如何将配置经验蒸馏为关于条件依赖关系的可复用知识，并将其内化到路由器的执行前规划策略中，从而改进系统层面在准确率与成本之间的权衡？

paragraphs.en: Addressing this question presents two challenges, as highlighted in Figure 2 . (i) Discovering reusable routing principles within a complex, multidimensional configuration space. Jointly selecting models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills causes a combinatorial explosion in the configuration space, making exhaustive evaluation computationally prohibitive ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Moreover, because configuration benefits depend on both the task and the combination of choices, a single execution trajectory reveals only the outcome under a specific configuration ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . It provides insufficient evidence to identify necessary, redundant, or suboptimal decisions. The router must therefore move beyond learning from isolated outcomes and analyze execution trajectories across tasks and configurations to uncover conditional configuration patterns that generalize to subsequent tasks. (ii) Translating post-execution experience into fine-grained supervision for pre-execution routing. Existing reinforcement learning approaches to routing derive reward signals solely from highly sparse feedback on final task success and computational cost ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2026 ) . However, a complete MAS configuration involves multiple coupled planning decisions. Terminal rewards provide limited guidance on which decisions are effective, which waste resources, and how individual configuration choices should be adjusted. Even when valuable routing insights can be distilled from historical trajectories, they do not automatically translate into effective action selection at specific decision states of the current routing policy. This mismatch between high-dimensional combinatorial decisions and coarse, sparse execution feedback limits the router’s ability to learn efficiently and improve continually from limited execution experience.
paragraphs.zh: 解决这一问题面临两大挑战，如图 2 所示。 （i）在复杂、多维的配置空间中发现可复用的路由原则。 联合选择模型、协作模式、智能体数量、交互轮次和技能会导致配置空间出现组合爆炸，使得穷举式评估在计算上不可行（Wang et al., 2025）。 此外，由于配置收益同时取决于任务和选择的组合，单次执行轨迹只能揭示特定配置下的结果（Yu et al., 2026）。 它不足以提供证据来识别哪些决策是必要的、冗余的或次优的。 因此，路由器必须超越从孤立结果中学习的方式，转而分析跨任务和跨配置的执行轨迹，以发现能够泛化到后续任务的条件性配置模式。 （ii）将执行后的经验转化为执行前路由的细粒度监督。 现有的基于强化学习的路由方法仅从最终任务成功和计算成本的高度稀疏反馈中获取奖励信号（Zhang et al., 2025；Cui et al., 2026；Liao et al., 2026）。 然而，一个完整的 MAS 配置涉及多个相互耦合的规划决策。 终端奖励对于哪些决策有效、哪些决策浪费资源以及各个配置选择应如何调整所提供的指导十分有限。 即使能够从历史轨迹中提炼出有价值的路由洞见，它们也不会自动转化为当前路由策略在特定决策状态下的有效动作选择。 高维组合决策与粗糙、稀疏的执行反馈之间的这种错配，限制了路由器从有限执行经验中高效学习和持续改进的能力。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose EvoRouter , an adaptive multi-agent routing framework built around an insight-guided self-improvement loop. To address the first challenge , we conduct preliminary experiments that systematically examine how configuration changes affect reasoning performance and computational cost across tasks, revealing task dependence, diminishing marginal returns, and configuration interdependence. We then design an LLM-based expert that distills routing insights by periodically aggregating configurations, execution outcomes, and costs across tasks. The expert derives conditional insights into task-specific capability bottlenecks, marginal returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. These insights guide exploration according to task characteristics, steering the router toward optimal configurations. To address the second challenge , we develop a router training method that combines privileged on-policy distillation (OPD) with cost-aware reinforcement learning (RL). OPD transforms configuration insights accumulated across trajectories into dense, token-level rewards informed by routing insights, while RL optimizes the performance–cost trade-off using end-to-end execution outcomes. These complementary training signals address the challenge of learning interdependent multi-agent configuration decisions from sparse execution feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 EvoRouter，这是一个自适应多智能体路由框架，其核心是洞察引导的自我改进循环。 为应对第一个挑战，我们开展了初步实验，系统性地考察配置变化如何影响不同任务上的推理性能与计算成本，揭示了任务依赖性、边际收益递减以及配置之间的相互依赖性。 随后，我们设计了一个基于大语言模型的专家，通过定期汇总跨任务的配置、执行结果与成本来提炼路由洞察。 该专家推导出针对任务特定能力瓶颈、资源扩展的边际收益以及配置选择之间交互作用的条件性洞察。 这些洞察根据任务特性引导探索，将路由器引向最优配置。 为应对第二个挑战，我们开发了一种将特权在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与成本感知强化学习（RL）相结合的路由器训练方法。 在线策略蒸馏将在各轨迹中积累的配置洞察转化为由路由洞察提供信息的密集的、词元级奖励，而强化学习则利用端到端的执行结果优化性能与成本之间的权衡。 这些互补的训练信号解决了从稀疏执行反馈中学习相互依赖的多智能体配置决策这一难题。

sents.en: To address these challenges, we propose EvoRouter , an adaptive multi-agent routing framework built around an insight-guided self-improvement loop.
sents.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 EvoRouter，这是一个自适应多智能体路由框架，其核心是洞察引导的自我改进循环。

sents.en: To address the first challenge , we conduct preliminary experiments that systematically examine how configuration changes affect reasoning performance and computational cost across tasks, revealing task dependence, diminishing marginal returns, and configuration interdependence.
sents.zh: 为应对第一个挑战，我们开展了初步实验，系统性地考察配置变化如何影响不同任务上的推理性能与计算成本，揭示了任务依赖性、边际收益递减以及配置之间的相互依赖性。

sents.en: We then design an LLM-based expert that distills routing insights by periodically aggregating configurations, execution outcomes, and costs across tasks.
sents.zh: 随后，我们设计了一个基于大语言模型的专家，通过定期汇总跨任务的配置、执行结果与成本来提炼路由洞察。

sents.en: The expert derives conditional insights into task-specific capability bottlenecks, marginal returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices.
sents.zh: 该专家推导出针对任务特定能力瓶颈、资源扩展的边际收益以及配置选择之间交互作用的条件性洞察。

sents.en: These insights guide exploration according to task characteristics, steering the router toward optimal configurations.
sents.zh: 这些洞察根据任务特性引导探索，将路由器引向最优配置。

sents.en: To address the second challenge , we develop a router training method that combines privileged on-policy distillation (OPD) with cost-aware reinforcement learning (RL).
sents.zh: 为应对第二个挑战，我们开发了一种将特权在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与成本感知强化学习（RL）相结合的路由器训练方法。

sents.en: OPD transforms configuration insights accumulated across trajectories into dense, token-level rewards informed by routing insights, while RL optimizes the performance–cost trade-off using end-to-end execution outcomes.
sents.zh: 在线策略蒸馏将在各轨迹中积累的配置洞察转化为由路由洞察提供信息的密集的、词元级奖励，而强化学习则利用端到端的执行结果优化性能与成本之间的权衡。

sents.en: These complementary training signals address the challenge of learning interdependent multi-agent configuration decisions from sparse execution feedback.
sents.zh: 这些互补的训练信号解决了从稀疏执行反馈中学习相互依赖的多智能体配置决策这一难题。

paragraphs.en: 1. Conditional routing insights distillation. We identify task dependence, diminishing marginal returns, and interdependence among MAS configuration choices. We distill cross-trajectory performance–cost feedback into configuration insights with explicit applicability conditions to guide exploration.

paragraphs.en: 3. Comprehensive empirical validation. We construct a benchmark covering 21 scenarios across seven domains, demonstrating that EvoRouter achieves better performance, lower cost, and greater robustness than representative baselines.

paragraphs.en: LLM routing spans per-query model selection ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Farahani et al., 2026a ; Farahani et al., 2026b ) and output-budget allocation ( Xue et al., 2026 ) , sequential model invocation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ) , and joint MAS configuration ( Yue et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ; Ke et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Beyond team design, routers adapt delegation ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) , agent or context selection ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and execution state ( Li et al., 2026b ; Rajib et al., 2026 ) . Experience-based approaches retain reusable routing knowledge ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Lin et al., 2026 ) or co-evolve routing with worker capabilities ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . RSI-Router ( Li et al., 2026a ) evolves subtask assignments and model-specific skills through Pareto selection. EvoRouter targets pre-execution joint configuration over fixed heterogeneous workers, informed by our analysis of task-dependent scaling and configuration interactions.

paragraphs.en: LLM post-training commonly combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on demonstrations with preference optimization ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards further develops reasoning capabilities from outcome feedback ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . Complementing reward-based optimization, on-policy distillation provides teacher supervision on student-generated sequences and can reduce the training–inference distribution mismatch associated with offline distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) . Recent methods enrich this supervision with textual feedback ( Hübotter et al., 2026 ) , trajectory-derived skills ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , and role-specific coordination feedback ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Building on these principles, EvoRouter combines group-relative RL with OPD on student-generated configuration plans, conditioning the teacher on evolving cross-task insights and current execution feedback. The resulting policy operates without privileged feedback at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的后训练通常将在演示数据上的监督微调（SFT）与偏好优化相结合（Ouyang et al., 2022；Rafailov et al., 2023）。 带可验证奖励的强化学习进一步从结果反馈中发展推理能力（Guo et al., 2025）。 作为对基于奖励的优化的补充，在线策略蒸馏在学生生成的序列上提供教师监督，并可以减少离线蒸馏中训练与推理分布不匹配的问题（Agarwal et al., 2024）。 近期的方法通过文本反馈（Hübotter et al., 2026）、从轨迹中提取的技能（Wang et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2026）以及针对特定角色的协调反馈（Zhong et al., 2026）来丰富这种监督。 基于这些原则，EvoRouter 将组相对强化学习与在线策略蒸馏相结合，作用于学生生成的配置方案，并以不断演化的跨任务洞察和当前执行反馈来调节教师。 由此得到的策略在推理时无需特权反馈即可运行。

paragraphs.en: Efficient MAS routing requires determining which resources to scale, to what extent , and how to combine them. Using m α m_{\alpha} (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) and m β m_{\beta} (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) as representative backbones, we systematically examine how resource selection, scaling scale, and configuration combinations govern task success and compute cost. Figure 3 highlights three key insights.
paragraphs.zh: 高效的 MAS 路由需要确定扩展哪些资源、扩展到何种程度，以及如何组合它们。 以 m α m_{\alpha}（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）和 m β m_{\beta}（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）作为代表性骨干模型，我们系统地考察了资源选择、扩展规模以及配置组合如何决定任务成功与否和计算成本。 图 3 突出了三个关键洞见。

paragraphs.en: Where to Scale? Different tasks exhibit distinct capability demands, leading to task-dependent benefits from resource scaling. As shown in Figure 3 (a), switching from m β + IO m_{\beta}+\mathrm{IO} to m α + FullConnected m_{\alpha}+\mathrm{FullConnected} improves the success rate on Multimodal by 13.1 points, while reducing that on QA tasks by 5.0 points. This suggests that scaling decisions should be driven by task demands, prioritizing task-aligned resource configurations (Insight 1).
paragraphs.zh: 在哪里扩展？ 不同任务表现出不同的能力需求，因此资源扩展带来的收益依赖于具体任务。 如图 3 (a) 所示，从 m β + IO m_{\beta}+\mathrm{IO} 切换到 m α + FullConnected m_{\alpha}+\mathrm{FullConnected} 使 Multimodal 上的成功率提升了 13.1 个百分点，同时使 QA 任务上的成功率下降了 5.0 个百分点。 这表明扩展决策应由任务需求驱动，优先采用与任务对齐的资源配置（洞见 1）。

paragraphs.en: How Much to Scale? Increasing resource allocation does not necessarily yield proportional gains. Figure 3 (b) shows that different models and collaboration strategies reach peak performance at different interaction rounds or agent counts, beyond which further scaling may increase costs while degrading success rates. Thus, resource scaling exhibits configuration-dependent saturation points, and the allocation scale should be tailored to the underlying model and collaboration strategy (Insight 2).
paragraphs.zh: 扩展到什么程度？ 增加资源分配并不一定会带来成比例的收益。 图 3 (b) 显示，不同的模型和协作策略在不同的交互轮数或智能体数量下达到性能峰值，超过该点后，进一步扩展可能增加成本，同时降低成功率。 因此，资源扩展表现出依赖于配置的饱和点，分配规模应根据底层模型和协作策略进行调整（洞察 2）。

paragraphs.en: What to Combine? The effectiveness of individual resources depends on their interactions within the overall configuration. paragraphs.en: Together, these insights guide subsequent insights distillation from three complementary perspectives: task alignment, scaling saturation, and configuration interactions. paragraphs.en: We deploy the router in an online environment and sample execution trajectories from a training set spanning diverse capability dimensions. Building on the observations from our preliminary experiments (Section 4 ), we develop an insight distillation expert to analyze these trajectories and continually refine routing insights. The expert integrates newly observed routing patterns from recent online trajectories with accumulated insights, capturing task-dependent preferences for resources and subtask decomposition strategies across different domains, difficulty levels, and budgets. This process enables routing knowledge to evolve continuously as new execution insights accumulate, as detailed in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将路由器部署到在线环境中，并从涵盖多种能力维度的训练集中采样执行轨迹。 基于初步实验（第4节）中的观察，我们开发了一个洞察蒸馏专家来分析这些轨迹，并持续优化路由洞察。 该专家将近期的在线轨迹中新观察到的路由模式与已积累的洞察相整合，捕捉不同领域、难度级别和预算下对资源与子任务分解策略的任务相关偏好。 这一过程使路由知识能够随着新的执行洞察不断积累而持续演进，具体详见第4.4节。

paragraphs.en: We compare five categories of methods. (I) Vanilla LLMs: Direct inference using individual models from the LLM pool. paragraphs.en: We presented EvoRouter, a framework that learns to jointly configure heterogeneous LLM-based MAS from execution experience. Combining cost-aware reinforcement learning with on-policy distillation, EvoRouter internalizes cross-task configuration insights and trajectory feedback into its routing policy, enabling deployment without privileged feedback. Across 21 datasets spanning seven domains, EvoRouter achieves higher average accuracy at lower computational cost than the evaluated routing baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Our current framework is designed for cloud-based agent services. Future work will extend EvoRouter to resource-constrained edge environments through coordinated cloud–edge routing that accounts for device heterogeneity and inter-agent communication overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EvoRouter，一个从执行经验中学习联合配置异构的基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）的框架。 EvoRouter 将成本感知强化学习与在策略蒸馏相结合，把跨任务配置洞察和轨迹反馈内化到其路由策略中，从而无需特权反馈即可部署。 在横跨七个领域的 21 个数据集上，EvoRouter 在域内和域外设置中均以更低的计算成本取得了比所评估的路由基线更高的平均准确率。 我们当前的框架是为基于云的智能体服务设计的。 未来的工作将通过考虑设备异构性和智能体间通信开销的云边协同路由，把 EvoRouter 扩展到资源受限的边缘环境。

paragraphs.en: All LLMs in the pool use temperature 1.0 and maximum output length 1,024 tokens (4,096 for code tasks). paragraphs.en: Details of the collaboration modes are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 协作模式的详情如下：

paragraphs.en: IO : A single agent answers in a single turn.
paragraphs.zh: IO：单个智能体在单轮中作答。

paragraphs.en: CoT : A single agent reasons step-by-step across multiple turns before delivering the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: CoT：单个智能体在多轮交互中逐步推理，然后给出最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Reflection : A single agent iteratively reflects on its previous response to generate a revised answer.
paragraphs.zh: 反思：单个智能体对其之前的回答进行迭代反思，以生成修改后的答案。

paragraphs.en: Self-Consistency : A single agent is invoked multiple times independently. A subsequent invocation then inspects all candidate answers, evaluates consistency, resolves discrepancies, and aggregates the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 自洽性：同一个智能体被独立地多次调用。 随后的调用会检查所有候选答案，评估一致性，解决分歧，并汇总出最终结果。

sents.en: Self-Consistency : A single agent is invoked multiple times independently.
sents.zh: 自洽性：同一个智能体被独立地多次调用。

sents.en: A subsequent invocation then inspects all candidate answers, evaluates consistency, resolves discrepancies, and aggregates the final result.
sents.zh: 随后的调用会检查所有候选答案，评估一致性，解决分歧，并汇总出最终结果。

paragraphs.en: Chain : Agents are activated sequentially, each receiving its predecessor’s output. When an agent exhausts its allocated reasoning turns, the next agent is triggered.
paragraphs.zh: 链式：智能体按顺序依次被激活，每个智能体接收其前一个智能体的输出。 当一个智能体用完其分配的推理轮次后，将触发下一个智能体。

sents.en: When an agent exhausts its allocated reasoning turns, the next agent is triggered.
sents.zh: 当一个智能体用完其分配的推理轮次后，将触发下一个智能体。

paragraphs.en: FullConnected : All agents are activated concurrently, receiving peers’ responses from the prior turn. Final-turn responses are routed to the router to synthesize the answer.
paragraphs.zh: FullConnected：所有智能体并发激活，接收上一轮来自其他智能体的响应。 最后一轮的响应会被路由到路由器以综合生成最终答案。

sents.en: Final-turn responses are routed to the router to synthesize the answer.
sents.zh: 最后一轮的响应会被路由到路由器以综合生成最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Debate : All agents run concurrently, critiquing peers or rebutting critiques in subsequent turns. Final-turn responses are routed to the router for answer synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 辩论：所有智能体并发运行，在后续轮次中批评同伴或反驳批评意见。 最后一轮的回复被路由到路由器以进行答案合成。

sents.en: Final-turn responses are routed to the router for answer synthesis.
sents.zh: 最后一轮的回复被路由到路由器以进行答案合成。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical : The initial agent plans task decomposition and scheduling, intermediate agents execute independently in parallel, and the final agent synthesizes findings. Turn limits govern reasoning turns per agent.
paragraphs.zh: 分层式：初始智能体负责任务分解与调度，中间各智能体独立并行执行，最终由最后一个智能体综合各发现结果。 回合上限控制每个智能体的推理回合数。

sents.zh: 分层式：初始智能体负责任务分解与调度，中间各智能体独立并行执行，最终由最后一个智能体综合各发现结果。

paragraphs.en: For each training task domain, we set a shared budget in our cost units. We calibrate it from pre-collected successful traces by computing the 25th percentile of trace costs for each question, taking the median across questions in the domain, and adding a 15% margin, with a minimum budget of 512. Budgets vary across domains (as well as trace collections); for example, the budget for the math tasks is 12,374.00, and 5,722.02 for commonsense tasks.

paragraphs.en: For supervised initialization, DeepSeek-V4-Pro serves as a bootstrap router to collect trajectories, yielding 2,000 filtered instances to fine-tune each backbone for 2 epochs. In subsequent training, we use a batch size of 8 with 16 rollouts per question and a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} , setting β = 0.001 \beta=0.001 , c max = 0.1 c_{\mathrm{max}}=0.1 , λ D = 0.03 \lambda_{D}=0.03 , and α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 . For on-policy distillation, Qwen3-32B and Llama-3.1-70B serve as teachers for the Qwen and Llama backbones, respectively. DeepSeek-V4-Pro also acts as the insight distillation expert, leveraging its context window and reasoning capabilities to analyze dozens of trajectories simultaneously, but does not directly supervise the student. Finally, we cap insight capacity at | ℐ | ≤ 8 |\mathcal{I}|\leq 8 and total length at 6,144 characters to limit context overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 在监督初始化阶段，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 作为引导路由器来收集轨迹，得到 2,000 条经过筛选的实例，用于对每个骨干模型进行 2 个 epoch 的微调。 在后续训练中，我们使用批次大小为 8、每个问题 16 次 rollout 的设置，学习率为 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} ，并设定 β = 0.001 \beta=0.001 、 c max = 0.1 c_{\mathrm{max}}=0.1 、 λ D = 0.03 \lambda_{D}=0.03 以及 α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 。 在在线策略蒸馏中，Qwen3-32B 和 Llama-3.1-70B 分别作为 Qwen 骨干和 Llama 骨干的教师模型。 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 还充当洞察蒸馏专家，利用其上下文窗口和推理能力同时分析数十条轨迹，但不直接监督学生模型。 最后，我们将洞察容量限制在 | ℐ | ≤ 8 |\mathcal{I}|\leq 8 ，将总长度限制在 6,144 个字符，以控制上下文开销。

paragraphs.en: Vanilla LLMs : Directly use the corresponding LLM to generate responses in a single-turn interaction.
paragraphs.zh: Vanilla LLMs：直接使用相应的 LLM 在单轮交互中生成回复。

paragraphs.en: RouteLLM ( Ong et al., 2025 ) : A classifier-based binary routing method that chooses between GLM-5 and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B for each query based on the predicted win rate of the stronger model against a fixed threshold.
paragraphs.zh: RouteLLM (Ong et al., 2025)：一种基于分类器的二选一路由方法，根据强模型胜率的预测值与固定阈值的比较，为每个查询在 GLM-5 和 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 之间做出选择。

paragraphs.en: GraphRouter ( Feng et al., 2025 ) : Models relations among tasks, queries, and candidate LLMs with a heterogeneous graph, employing a graph neural network to select the suitable model.
paragraphs.zh: GraphRouter（Feng et al., 2025）：利用异构图对任务、查询和候选 LLM 之间的关系进行建模，并采用图神经网络来选择合适的模型。

paragraphs.en: ICL-Router ( Wang et al., 2026a ) : Constructs capability representations of candidate models from historical performance and routes each query to the model predicted to be the best.
paragraphs.zh: ICL-Router（Wang et al., 2026a）：从历史性能中构建候选模型的能力表示，并将每个查询路由到预测为最佳的模型。

paragraphs.en: RouterDC ( Chen et al., 2024 ) : A dual contrastive learning based routing approach that selects an LLM based on the similarity between the query and candidate capability vectors.
paragraphs.zh: RouterDC (Chen et al., 2024)：一种基于双重对比学习的路由方法，根据查询与候选能力向量之间的相似度来选择大语言模型（LLM）。

paragraphs.en: Router-R1 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : An RL-based agentic routing method where the router actively dispatches sub-tasks to candidate models during reasoning and aggregates returned information to synthesize the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: Router-R1（Zhang et al., 2025）：一种基于强化学习的智能体路由方法，其中路由器在推理过程中主动将子任务分派给候选模型，并聚合返回的信息以合成最终答案。

paragraphs.en: ReCal ( Yu et al., 2026 ) : An RL-based agentic routing method following routing behaviors similar to Router-R1 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , enhancing policy optimization under multi-task and multi-objective settings via reward decomposition and calibration.
paragraphs.zh: ReCal ( Yu et al., 2026 )：一种基于强化学习的智能体路由方法，遵循与 Router-R1 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) 类似的路由行为，通过奖励分解与校准，增强多任务和多目标设置下的策略优化。

paragraphs.en: xRouter ( Qian et al., 2025 ) : A multi-turn routing method that allows the router to answer directly, invoke candidate models, or select an existing model response as the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: xRouter（Qian et al., 2025）：一种多轮路由方法，允许路由器直接回答、调用候选模型，或选择已有的模型响应作为最终答案。

paragraphs.en: MAS-Orchestra ( Ke et al., 2026 ) : Encapsulates diverse collaborative reasoning patterns into callable modules coordinated by an orchestrator, using GLM-5 as the LLM backbone.
paragraphs.zh: MAS-Orchestra（Ke et al., 2026）：将多样化的协作推理模式封装为可调用的模块，由一个编排器进行协调，并使用 GLM-5 作为大语言模型骨干。

paragraphs.en: OrchMAS ( Feng et al., 2026 ) : Dynamically instantiates agent roles and task prompts while advancing problem-solving via runtime agent feedback, adopting GLM-5 as the backbone.
paragraphs.zh: OrchMAS（Feng et al., 2026）：动态实例化智能体角色与任务提示，同时通过运行时智能体反馈推进问题求解，采用 GLM-5 作为骨干模型。

paragraphs.en: DAAO ( Su et al., 2026 ) : Dynamically selects reasoning operators and their LLM backbones based on predicted problem difficulty, constructing an adaptive hierarchical collaborative workflow for each query.
paragraphs.zh: DAAO (Su et al., 2026)：基于预测的问题难度，动态选择推理算子及其 LLM 骨干模型，为每个查询构建自适应的分层协作工作流。

paragraphs.en: MasRouter ( Yue et al., 2025b ) : Employs cascaded controllers to select collaboration modes, agent counts, roles, and LLM backbones, instantiating tailored MAS per query.
paragraphs.zh: MasRouter ( Yue et al., 2025b )：采用级联控制器来选择协作模式、智能体数量、角色和大语言模型骨干，为每个查询实例化定制的多智能体系统（MAS）。

paragraphs.en: RCR-Router ( Liu et al., 2026 ) : Allocates shared memory to agents based on task-role relevance, where all agents are backed by GLM-5 and iteratively analyze and answer queries according to a predefined topology.
paragraphs.zh: RCR-Router（Liu et al., 2026）：根据任务角色相关性为智能体分配共享内存，其中所有智能体均由 GLM-5 支撑，并按照预定义的拓扑结构迭代地分析并回答查询。

paragraphs.en: AgentRouter ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) : Employs a knowledge graph to characterize relationships among queries, entities, and candidate agents, using a GNN to compute a weighted aggregation of responses across model-strategy combinations.
